description: Reproducible DRRA evaluation-lab topology. The control plane is provisioned by docker-compose.yml (runnable here). The endpoint tier describes the victim hosts that generate attack telemetry; live VM provisioning is external evidence (Future), but the recipe is pinned and every host's scenarios map to the OTRF datasets DRRA already ingests (DRRA-076), so the same behaviour can be replayed offline today.

endpoint_tier.note: Windows victim hosts. Boxes and versions are pinned for reproducibility. Standing up the live VMs and collecting fresh telemetry is external evidence and remains Future (DRRA-077); the offline replay of each host's scenarios against pinned OTRF captures is available now.
